activity_statements.statement: discovers and develops biologic medicines using human genetic data, AI and generative biology for patients with cancer, heart disease, obesity, rare diseases and inflammatory conditions
manufactures biologic medicines through complex cell-based living-cell production processes at scale, maintaining a reputation for supply reliability across 100+ countries
delivers medicines commercially to patients in approximately 100 countries across four therapeutic areas: general medicine, rare diseases, inflammation and oncology
advances a broad pipeline of small molecules and biologics including treatments targeting obesity-related conditions (e.g. AMG 133) and multiple oncology programs
operates global supply chain for biologic medicines including cold-chain logistics and manufacturing quality systems required for cell-based therapeutics

name_reality_gap: Labeled Biotechnology Research; reality is a fully vertically integrated operation spanning discovery, cell-based manufacturing at industrial scale, global cold-chain distribution and commercial sales across 100 countries.
